methods.label: Equal chords and an isosceles triangle
methods.explanation: Equal arcs subtend equal chords, so \(AB=AC\). Thus, \(\angle ACB=\angle ABC=70^\circ\), and \(\angle BAC=180^\circ-70^\circ-70^\circ=40^\circ\).
